raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner erroneously changed John Everett Millais’s death date to 12 August 1896 and instructed returning 1896-08-12, despite sources already indicating 13 August 1896 (Britannica/Wikipedia) or only the year (Tate). This unjustified “timezone normalization” and misreading of sources led to the wrong date.
